class.name: NetwPersistenceHandle
class.brief_description: One entity's saved record, reached as [member NetwEntity.persistence].
class.description: On the server, the entity's [NetwPersistenceConfig] and its [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] properties become one record when the node is ready. If any of them is invalid, the entity saves nothing and an error names the property. [method Node._ready] runs before the record is read, so wait for [signal loaded] before using the stored values. [codeblock] func _on_chest_opened() -> void: var row := entity.persistence row.saved.connect(func() -> void: print("stored as ", row.record_id)) row.save() [/codeblock] [method NetwPersistenceConfig.interval] saves automatically, and only when something changed. An entity whose node is freed saves one last time. Failed loads and saves emit [signal NetwDatabase.failed].

method.name: load
method.description: Reads the stored record and applies it to the bound properties. The promise returns [code]true[/code] when a record was found, and [code]false[/code] when none was stored and the properties keep their values. A failed load fails the promise, and [method NetwPromise.wait] returns the code. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the entity binds no persistence, the database is not open, │ or the schema declares no migration from the stored row ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_BUSY a bound property changed since the last load or save, a │ write is in flight, a property changed while the row was │ read, or the database is full ┠╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST a bound node was freed while the row was applied ┠╴ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED the stored row is not in this library's format, or carries │ a newer storage version than the schema ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the stored row does not match the schema ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the database closed or │ the session ended while the row was read ┖╴backend-defined the backend could not read the row [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: save
method.description: Writes the bound properties as this entity's record. The promise returns [code]false[/code] when nothing had changed. A failed save fails the promise, and [method NetwPromise.wait] returns the code. The entity stays [member dirty] so the next save tries again. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED the entity binds no persistence, or the database is not open ┠╴ERR_UNAUTHORIZED this peer is not the server ┠╴ERR_BUSY a write is in flight, the spawn load has not succeeded, or │ the database is full ┠╴ERR_INVALID_DATA the bound values do not match the schema, or the connection │ answered no outcome for the row ┠╴ERR_UNAVAILABLE the bound nodes are gone, or this peer stopped being the │ server or the database closed before the write finished. │ The write may still have reached storage ┖╴backend-defined the backend refused or could not complete the write [/codeblock] [b]Server Only.[/b]

members.member: The [NetwDatabase] this record lives in, as [method NetwPersistenceConfig.database] named it.
Whether any bound property differs from what was last saved.
The id this record is stored under, as [method NetwPersistenceConfig.record_id] returned it.

signal.name: loaded
signal.description: Emitted when a load finishes, including the one [method NetwPersistenceConfig.load_on_spawn] starts. [param found] is [code]false[/code] when no record was stored for [member record_id].

signal.name: saved
signal.description: Emitted when a save is stored.
